nodes.label: Option 1: Inductive Temporal-Per-Node Encoder Plus Inductive Spatial Message Passing
nodes.norm_label: option 1: inductive temporal-per-node encoder plus inductive spatial message passing
nodes.rationale: Recommended first: the only family size-agnostic by construction, needing no node identities, with a small trunk friendly to MAML and adapters; cost is some in-distribution accuracy versus adaptive-graph models, which is the price of transferability.

nodes.label: Option 2: STGCN-Style GCN Plus Gated TCN
nodes.norm_label: option 2: stgcn-style gcn plus gated tcn
nodes.rationale: Recommended second as the efficient fully-inductive comparator; limited to a predefined graph, which is acceptable because latent-graph learning is what breaks transfer.

nodes.label: Option 3: DCRNN-Style Diffusion Plus Recurrence
nodes.rationale: Conditional: the core operator is inductive but the autoregressive seq2seq decoder conflicts with direct multi-horizon and recurrent rollout is slow at 7,165 nodes on 8 GB.

nodes.label: Option 4: Adaptive-Graph STGNNs (REJECT for shared trunk)
nodes.norm_label: option 4: adaptive-graph stgnns (reject for shared trunk)
nodes.rationale: Learned node embeddings are transductive, indexed by node and sized by N, so weights cannot move across graph sizes and would encode disease identity; the gated dilated TCN and diffusion conv minus the adaptive term are salvageable.

nodes.label: Option 6: Spatio-Temporal Transformers
nodes.rationale: Attention can be made inductive and GMAN's transform-attention decoder fits direct multi-horizon, but O(TN^2)/O(NT^2) cost is prohibitive at 7,165 nodes on 8 GB; viable only for the 10-61 node graphs.

nodes.label: Option 7: Pre-Trained ST and Time-Series Foundation Encoders
nodes.norm_label: option 7: pre-trained st and time-series foundation encoders
nodes.rationale: Use a small TSFM as the per-node temporal module or a zero-shot baseline, but do not adopt a large frozen foundation model as the whole trunk: 8 GB, SHAP transparency and few-shot inner loops all argue against it.

nodes.label: Option 8: Epidemic Pre-Trained Temporal Models (CAPE / PEMS)
nodes.norm_label: option 8: epidemic pre-trained temporal models (cape / pems)
nodes.rationale: Closest prior art: they prove cross-disease pre-training works but are purely temporal with no spatial encoder, which is the exact gap this project fills. Treat as must-cite baselines and a pre-training template.

nodes.label: SHAP Attribution on the Latent
nodes.rationale: Cleanest on a low-dimensional stable latent, expensive and unstable on large attention stacks and opaque on frozen foundation models.

nodes.label: GNN Size-Transferability Theory (Graphons and Graphops)
nodes.rationale: Supports carry-over across differently sized graphs when the local operator is shared, but the guarantees are asymptotic and assume structurally similar graphs, so a 10 to 7,165 node range must be validated not assumed.

nodes.rationale: As shipped, influenza nodes carried twice the self-weight of dengue nodes inside the shared model, a structural signature from which the model could infer the disease.

nodes.label: C9: Geographic Covariates Withheld from the Shared Model

nodes.rationale: The three diseases occupy disjoint parts of the world, so a coordinate identifies the disease outright; populating centroids for all three did not make them safe to expose.

nodes.label: Filter A: No Node Identities, Size-Agnostic
nodes.norm_label: filter a: no node identities, size-agnostic
nodes.rationale: Shared weights may not contain any parameter indexed by node or sized by N, which immediately disqualifies transductive adaptive-graph learners.

nodes.label: Filter B: Direct Multi-Horizon, Factorisable, Cheap at 7,165 Nodes
nodes.norm_label: filter b: direct multi-horizon, factorisable, cheap at 7,165 nodes
nodes.rationale: Favours factorised temporal-then-spatial designs with a direct multi-head output and penalises O(N^2) dense spatial attention or per-node recurrence at dengue scale.

nodes.label: Filter C: Few-Shot, Conformal and SHAP Friendliness
nodes.norm_label: filter c: few-shot, conformal and shap friendliness
nodes.rationale: Favours a small shared trunk with a light adaptation surface, stable latent features, and no reliance on a held-out calibration split.

nodes.label: Transductive Node Embeddings as a Disqualifying Pattern
nodes.norm_label: transductive node embeddings as a disqualifying pattern
nodes.rationale: Parameters indexed by node hard-wire a fixed node count and leak disease identity; inductivity comes from parameter-sharing over local neighbourhoods, not from node lookups.

nodes.label: Domain Generalisation Discharged Structurally
nodes.rationale: transfer_view() exposes only the four core channels, static covariates C are withheld from the shared encoder and the influenza self-loop convention was harmonised, each because it is a feature from which the encoder could infer which disease it is looking at. That is invariance enforced in code rather than by an objective.

nodes.rationale: SHAP over a spatio-temporal GNN with 7,165 regions is a serious compute proposition and with four input channels it is not obvious what is being attributed over; integrated gradients is probably more tractable.

nodes.label: Phase 3 Week 3 Results Summary
nodes.rationale: Single-disease and joint multi-disease results over four development datasets, four horizons and five seeds, in count space, with Ebola untouched.

nodes.label: A1: Finest-Available Dengue Spatial Resolution
nodes.rationale: Admin-1 only would have excluded Brazil entirely, since its weekly reporting exists only at municipality level, and would have taken Colombia's modern series with it; the cost is 7,165 nodes with Brazil supplying 77% of them, mitigated by a within-country-then-across-country headline metric that does not yet exist.

nodes.label: C4: Taiwan Aggregated from Townships to Counties
nodes.norm_label: c4: taiwan aggregated from townships to counties
nodes.rationale: No township shapefile layer exists and townships partition counties exactly, so the sum is exact; the alternative was to drop Taiwan.

nodes.label: D2: Twenty-Nine Japanese Prefectures Report Zero Dengue
nodes.norm_label: d2: twenty-nine japanese prefectures report zero dengue
nodes.rationale: The zeros are true and the nodes remain valid graph neighbours, but under a country-averaged headline Japan carries one twelfth of the score while 62% of its nodes are trivially predictable.

nodes.label: Block-Diagonal Joint Supergraph
nodes.rationale: Verified rather than assumed: nothing in the encoder reduces over the node dimension and there is no BatchNorm, so each block's math is identical alone or inside the supergraph and no cross-block edges means no inter-dataset leakage. Locked as a permanent equivalence gate.

nodes.label: C8 Runtime Ebola-Exclusion Guard
nodes.rationale: The guarantee had been structural only, through exclusion from the bundle list; it is now asserted at the actual selection points so any future caller trips immediately regardless of how the dataset list was built.

nodes.label: Cell-Pooled versus Node-Averaged Metric Caveat
nodes.rationale: The saved sufficient statistics are node-pooled within each country, so the reconstructed country-macro is cell-pooled while the headline metric is node-averaged; they coincide on dense influenza panels and diverge on dengue, and an exact-headline CI would need a ~1.8 GB per-node artifact.

nodes.label: Persistence-Anchor Delta Target (open)
nodes.rationale: Predicting the change from the last observed value needs no new channel and attacks both short-horizon persistence losses and long-horizon mean reversion, but may over-mean-revert at h10/h15 where the model currently wins.

nodes.label: Persist Granular Per-Node and Per-Origin Scores
nodes.norm_label: persist granular per-node and per-origin scores
nodes.rationale: A bootstrap CI or a paired Wilcoxon cannot be reconstructed from a mean, so per-node scores and per-origin by country sufficient statistics are persisted.

nodes.label: P9 Topology Augmentation Deferred
nodes.rationale: Edge dropout and annealing do not exist, so the primary 2x2 ablation cannot run; building it would spend a day protecting a spatial channel whose value the Day-14 transfer result puts in question.

nodes.label: Paired Bootstrap Over Time Origins
nodes.rationale: Resampling the same origins for both models and building the CI on the difference is what makes it robust to japan's plus or minus 7-10% seed sd; Wilcoxon across five seed-matched runs is underpowered and supporting only.

nodes.label: One Shared Encoder Plus One Adapter Per Dataset
nodes.norm_label: one shared encoder plus one adapter per dataset
nodes.rationale: A single shared adapter fitting dengue and influenza scales would fight itself and undercut the shared-trunk claim; the trunk is the transferable asset and adapters are throwaways, which is exactly the Ebola path.

nodes.label: Quantile Crossing Fixed by a Post-Hoc Sort
nodes.norm_label: quantile crossing fixed by a post-hoc sort
nodes.rationale: A plain Linear head can emit crossing quantiles, which hurts intervals but not the median; sorting at inference avoids a head-architecture change that would force a full retrain.

nodes.label: Samplers Become Loss Weights Under Block-Diagonal Batching
nodes.norm_label: samplers become loss weights under block-diagonal batching
nodes.rationale: Every dataset is in every batch, so a naive mean over 7,271 nodes hands dengue 98.5% of the gradient. Across-dataset and within-dengue weights compose cleanly, and per-cell country balance is used because observation density spans 97x and per-node balancing would not actually balance them.

nodes.label: Seasonal Amplitude Gap Accepted as a Limitation
nodes.norm_label: seasonal amplitude gap accepted as a limitation
nodes.rationale: Zeroing sin/cos costs about 0.07 PCC, so the encoder does use seasonal phase; what is missing is last year's amplitude, which a 20-week lookback cannot reach. Feeding y[t-52] breaks the four-core-channel constraint and does nothing for Ebola, which has no year-over-year history.

nodes.label: Training Defined in Steps, Not Epochs
nodes.norm_label: training defined in steps, not epochs
nodes.rationale: With four datasets at a fixed per-step ratio an epoch is meaningless, since one pass over dengue is about 24 passes over japan; the cost is losing the intuitive budget and having to pick step numbers by hand.

nodes.label: Persistence and Support-Mean Floors
nodes.rationale: Seasonal-naive is dropped rather than reported as a third floor: Ebola has T=52 so the t-52 lag is out of panel at every scored origin and it would collapse to a duplicate of persistence.

nodes.label: Compute-Matching Rule (Outer Steps = 91,000/(K+1))
nodes.rationale: Holds trunk gradient evaluations constant so the existing ERM LDO runs become a valid matched ablation with no rerun, the largest single saving available; the caveat is that matched compute may leave the meta arm under-trained relative to its own convergence.

nodes.label: Do Not Add a t-52 Lag Channel
nodes.norm_label: do not add a t-52 lag channel
nodes.rationale: It would fix the benchmark row, but Ebola has no prior year so the channel would be permanently null for the actual target: a train and target mismatch introduced to win a table cell.

nodes.label: Build the Learned Graph Gate Figure
nodes.norm_label: build the learned graph gate figure
nodes.rationale: Gate values of 0.27 to 0.60 scaling with region count and density is already an interpretable result and is being under-used.

nodes.label: Try the Obvious Joint-Training Remedies Before Declaring Failure
nodes.norm_label: try the obvious joint-training remedies before declaring failure
nodes.rationale: Dengue is about 98% of training examples, so a reviewer will ask whether the sampler was balanced; if balanced or temperature-scaled sampling, per-disease loss reweighting and per-dataset normalisation still fail, the negative result stops reading as an unfinished experiment.

nodes.label: No Linear Predictability at h10 and h15 on the Test Fold
nodes.norm_label: no linear predictability at h10 and h15 on the test fold
nodes.rationale: Test-fold lag-10 autocorrelation is +0.015 and lag-15 is -0.048 while train carries +0.350 and +0.282, so no model can beat a constant there; this is a property of the data provable without running anything and is the single largest term in the deficit.

nodes.label: Joint Training Helps Nothing and Hurts the Smallest Datasets
nodes.norm_label: joint training helps nothing and hurts the smallest datasets
nodes.rationale: Dengue is flat by construction because it is 98.5% of the nodes, so it is not a test; the small panels that are the real test got worse, and they are the Ebola-scale ones. Two explanations were undistinguished by that run: genuine negative transfer, or a weighting artifact from over-cycling tiny data.

nodes.rationale: Guards in train/loop.py, train/lodo.py, train/joint.py and bundles.py now match on the ebola name prefix rather than the exact string, so ebola_L12 and ebola_L20 cannot slip past them.

nodes.label: L19 Dropped Support Arm
nodes.rationale: Recorded in the manifest as considered-and-rejected so the arm set cannot later be read as the only thing examined.

nodes.label: E3: Few-Shot Still Loses to Persistence on the Primary Arm
nodes.norm_label: e3: few-shot still loses to persistence on the primary arm
nodes.rationale: Moderate confidence; if wrong it is the best outcome available and will be said plainly.

nodes.label: E5: Secondary Arm Beats Primary at h10 and h15
nodes.norm_label: e5: secondary arm beats primary at h10 and h15
nodes.rationale: The single most informative cell: if the secondary arm does not win, the failure is not support-limited and no extra Ebola labelling rescues the few-shot framing.

nodes.label: L12 Primary Ebola Support Arm
nodes.rationale: 12-week cutoff 2014-06-28, 59 support cells over 18 districts; carries the headline because it is the operational emerging-outbreak regime. Has zero adaptation pairs at h15.

nodes.label: L20 Secondary Ebola Support Arm
nodes.rationale: 20-week cutoff 2014-08-23, 113 cells over 36 districts, labelled secondary in every table; worth its compute because if it does not beat L12 at h10/h15 the failure is not support-limited.

nodes.label: Support-Only log1p Plus Z-Score Scaler
nodes.rationale: Pooled scaler fit on support cells alone so each arm has its own; both arms remain mis-calibrated against the ~19-case mean scored cell, which is what the FiLM adapter is meant to correct.

nodes.label: Phase 2 Decisions for Client Confirmation
nodes.rationale: Four Part-A decisions with resolutions, six confirmations, unanticipated decisions that changed the data, and properties that affect how results must be read.

nodes.label: Ebola Support-Set Pre-Registration
nodes.rationale: Frozen 2026-08-07 before any Ebola score; nothing may be revised after the first score so the outcome is reported against what was written, making score-Ebola-once a stated methodological contribution.

nodes.label: A2: Dengue Case Definitions Accepted as Built and Disclosed
nodes.norm_label: a2: dengue case definitions accepted as built and disclosed
nodes.rationale: The headline multipliers up to x220 came from a raw-file group-by, not from any node's series; measured on the extracted data the genuine exposure is Mexico 2.8x and Bolivia 1.6x on 41 of 7,165 nodes, which does not justify discarding twenty years of history.

nodes.label: A3: Calendar-Prefix Ebola Support with a Fixed Cutoff
nodes.norm_label: a3: calendar-prefix ebola support with a fixed cutoff
nodes.rationale: Per-district first-two-weeks support was not calendar-causal: 85% of evaluation cells lay earlier in time than the last support cell, so normalisation drew on another district's peak-epidemic magnitudes. A fixed 2014-05-24 cutoff is causal by construction.

nodes.label: A4: Ebola Gap-Lumping Disclosed
nodes.rationale: A multi-week increment lands on the week the report arrives, so peaks are inflated and quiet weeks flattened; the alternatives either invent a distribution never observed or discard evaluation data.

nodes.label: C1: Weekly Incidence from the Running Maximum
nodes.norm_label: c1: weekly incidence from the running maximum
nodes.rationale: Differencing with a clip to zero treated a data-entry dropout as a revision and then counted the recovery as new incidence, fabricating 8,786 cases across 34 districts, 35.8% of the target, and displacing the national peak to February 2015. Differencing the running maximum conserves mass exactly and masks corrupt weeks.

nodes.label: C2: First Observed Week of Every District Masked
nodes.norm_label: c2: first observed week of every district masked
nodes.rationale: Assigning a district's cumulative total to date as its first week's new cases fabricated a backlog for every district and fed it into the normalisation of the whole held-out disease; at a first report there is no preceding figure to subtract.

nodes.label: C3: Per-Node Dengue Split Fallback Removed
nodes.norm_label: c3: per-node dengue split fallback removed
nodes.rationale: Re-cutting late-starting nodes on their own timeline placed their training cells inside their neighbours' test period, and a graph network aggregates over neighbours, so 475 nodes pulled test-period data into the training pass.

nodes.label: C8: Dengue Splits Cut Per Country
nodes.norm_label: c8: dengue splits cut per country
nodes.rationale: A single global chronological cut would have given zero training data to five countries silently, with no error raised.

nodes.label: D1: Zero-Variance Normalisation Guard Fixed
nodes.rationale: A blanket scale of one fired on 400 dengue nodes and left the 76 that vary in the held-out period un-normalised; a constant-in-training node now takes its country's pooled training statistics.

nodes.label: Negative Controls on Every Gate
nodes.rationale: The suite grew to 86 gates and six negative controls, each carrying a deliberately planted failure it must detect, because the number of tests passing was on its own worthless as evidence.

nodes.label: D16: Ebola Support Length, 12 Weeks Primary and 20 Weeks Secondary
nodes.norm_label: d16: ebola support length, 12 weeks primary and 20 weeks secondary
nodes.rationale: Both arms frozen and hashed before either is scored; query counts are identical under both arms so they differ only in labelled adaptation data, which is what makes them comparable. The Phase-2 ebola.npz build is superseded for scoring and the C8 guards were hardened to a prefix match as part of this.

nodes.label: Scored vs Reachable Query Counts
nodes.rationale: Scored (757/766/765/642) uses one common origin set t in [19,36] for every horizon, which is what bundles.origins() returns and score_predictions scores; reachable (1151/1075/866/642) counts per-horizon origins and overstates h3-h10 by 34-52 per cent. Horizons are comparable only if read at the same origins.

nodes.label: Score-Each-Arm-Once Protocol
nodes.rationale: Each arm scored exactly once against the frozen hashed file; a repeat for a defect must be recorded with its reason before the re-scored numbers are used.

nodes.label: Ebola Audit Request
nodes.rationale: The biggest open risk: resolution, usable origins, missingness across 61 units, adjacency, and how many labelled support examples exist. If Ebola comes in under the 27-example few-shot design floor the constraint was calibrated against the wrong thing.

nodes.label: Pre-Registration and Scoring Ebola Once
nodes.rationale: Adopted as a stated methodological contribution rather than an internal process note: cheap, unusual in this literature, and a credibility story when paired with the failure log.

nodes.label: The Omicron peak lands inside the COVID validation fold
nodes.norm_label: the omicron peak lands inside the covid validation fold
nodes.rationale: The national maximum (2022-01-15, 5.14M cases, 13.8x the median week) sits at val week 21 of 33, making the val mean 2.8x train and 2.8x test. Early stopping therefore selects on a once-in-the-panel event that never recurs in the scored period. The recommendation is still to keep fixed_50_20_30: protocol consistency across diseases is worth more than a better-conditioned COVID split, since moving the cut only for COVID would make its transfer cells incomparable to every other cell. An earlier 'train->test regime shift' note was wrong - the test/train national mean ratio is 1.03x; the shift is a spike inside val.

nodes.label: The Admin-2 key collision defect
nodes.rationale: Admin-2 unit names are not unique within a country - Brazil has 239 municipality names shared by two to five states - so a leaf-only key summed geographically distinct municipalities into one node (64,104 Brazilian cells, 413 collisions total) and also corrupted the coverage gate by pooling their observed weeks. Adding the parent province to the key took nodes 7,030 -> 7,443 (an increase of exactly the collision count) and duplicate (node, week) cells 74,952 -> 0, which retracts the earlier finding that those rows were legitimate sub-weekly reports: the original diagnostic could not distinguish the two cases because it counted duplicates under the broken key.

nodes.label: Dengue case definitions over time - measured, not asserted
nodes.norm_label: dengue case definitions over time - measured, not asserted
nodes.rationale: An adversarial review reported multipliers up to x220, computed by grouping the raw source file by case_definition_standardised - not a property of any node's time series. Measured per node on the extracted values the real exposure is Mexico 2.8x and Bolivia 1.6x across 41 of 7,165 nodes; Peru and the Dominican Republic are single-definition throughout. Kept as built and disclosed, since truncating to a single-definition era would remove real data to suppress a distortion smaller than the trend it is entangled with. The recurring lesson: a per-node-over-time question must be measured on the per-node series, not on a raw-file group-by.

nodes.label: The clip defect that fabricated 36 per cent of the Ebola target
nodes.norm_label: the clip defect that fabricated 36 per cent of the ebola target
nodes.rationale: The conversion ended in max(0, dC) on the reasoning that a downward step is reporting reconciliation. A cumulative count cannot fall: where the report falls, the report is a single-week data-entry dropout. The clip zeroed the fall and then released the recovery - the climb back to cases already counted - as new incidence, fabricating 8,786 cases (+35.8 per cent), putting the six largest cells in the dataset there as artefacts, and displacing the national peak from late 2014 to 2015-02-14. No check caught it because the suite compared the transform against nothing the transform had not itself produced.

nodes.label: COVID-19 bundle - NYT US states
nodes.rationale: Numbered §6 rather than inserted in disease order on purpose, because PROJECT.md and the progress record cite this note's section numbers and renumbering would silently break every reference. 49 nodes x 164 weeks, 100 per cent observed, reusing ColaGNN's state-adj.txt verbatim so it varies the disease and nothing else. Three costs travel with any number derived from it: Florida and DC are excluded (a 50th node would fork the adjacency and forfeit the identical-graph property), the adjacency is land contiguity built for influenza, and 2020-2023 is NPI-dominated so transfer may reflect policy response rather than pathogen dynamics. Until 2026-08-13 the loader hashed what it downloaded without comparing it to anything and the bundle was built outside build_datasets.py; folding it in took the suite from 86 to 101 gates and the rebuild was bit-identical.

nodes.label: Declared alterations to the dengue data
nodes.norm_label: declared alterations to the dengue data
nodes.rationale: Taiwan's 287 townships aggregated into 22 counties because GADM ships no township layer and no alias can supply a missing layer; seven post-vintage units folded into pre-split parents whose polygons still contain their territory; two concurrent Nicaraguan health districts summed - the one merger resting on an administrative reading rather than arithmetic, and flagged as such; four split series reunited (disjoint eras make the merge unambiguous, and DR then lands on exactly 32 nodes, corroborating it); one mislabelled Argentine node dropped with its reason declared. Brazil required no alterations at all.

nodes.label: Dengue name join and the two alias maps
nodes.norm_label: dengue name join and the two alias maps
nodes.rationale: 302 nodes failed the initial join; five Colombian department names alone orphaned 100 municipalities. Every alias is resolved by exact match against a real shapefile key, never fuzzily - approximate matching would have bound antioquia|san andres to andes, a different municipality. Folding GADM's own misspellings into the load-time map shipped nodes named japan|naoasaki and peru|huanuco|huenuco, propagating the shapefile's typos into identifiers that would have been printed in the paper's node table; a join-time map now absorbs them and never renames a node. Unmatched nodes halt construction.

nodes.label: Dengue bundle - OpenDengue best-spatial extract
nodes.rationale: 12 countries, 7,165 nodes, 1,409 weekly steps, mask density 0.2175. A national aggregate is never a node, because a country with a single national series is a graph singleton carrying no spatial-coupling signal - the very quantity the model exists to exploit; 57 otherwise-endemic countries are excluded on that basis. Level is resolved per country at the finest level clearing the coverage thresholds, since the coarsest-adequate rule would have selected Colombia's sparse 2001-2003 Admin-1 fragment over its much richer Admin-2 series.

nodes.label: Declared alterations to the Ebola data
nodes.norm_label: declared alterations to the ebola data
nodes.rationale: Port merged into Port Loko - one district recorded under two labels, the second beginning the day after the first ends and continuing the same cumulative series, which also dissolves the file's worst week-zero anomaly. Western Area dropped as the parent of its two children, which it overlaps in time and would triple-count; Freetown dropped as a city inside Western Area Urban with no district polygon, its five cases not folded in because it cannot be verified whether the district total already included them. An undeclared multi-district aggregate label raises an error rather than being quietly ingested.

nodes.label: Ebola bundle - OCHA ROWCA compilation
nodes.rationale: 61 districts over 52 weekly steps (2014-04-05 -> 2015-03-28), mask density 0.4095. A manual compilation of WHO and Ministry of Health situation reports, the only source in the project with no version number, so its checksum is its only version identifier. The recorded hash is that of the file as published: an earlier working copy had been opened and re-saved in a spreadsheet application, which rewrites the container without altering a cell, so a reviewer hashing their own download would have obtained a mismatch. Sierra Leone reports 17 district labels but has 14 districts, hence 64 raw labels against 61 nodes; administrative levels are mixed across countries, as in dengue.

nodes.label: Mass-conservation gate (cumulative_reference_mass)
nodes.rationale: Computes the implied mass directly from the source column, sharing only the weekly resampling with the transform and none of the increment logic, and fails the build if the weekly series sums to more than that reference. Added precisely because the original defect survived 83 gates: no check compared the transform against anything the transform had not itself produced.

nodes.label: Difference the running maximum (mass-preserving transform)
nodes.rationale: The monotone envelope absorbs a dropout: the affected week yields no increment and the recovery yields only the rise above the previous high-water mark, instead of re-releasing mass already counted. Mass-conserving by construction - increments sum to max(C) - C_first exactly. Weeks falling below the running maximum are masked because they are corrupt reports, not observations of zero. On the released build the target totals 24,552 against a reference of 24,552 and the national peak sits at 2014-10-25 (2,688 cases/week).

nodes.label: The week-zero backlog defect
nodes.rationale: Assigning each district's entire cumulative total to date as its week-zero incidence put 4.1 per cent of all incidence in week zero and handed 10 of 64 districts a false all-time maximum. The root cause is identifiability, not tuning: at a district's first report the predecessor cumulative is unknown, so the increment does not exist and assigning the total fabricates it. This is not a late-joining-district problem - the compilation opens months into an outbreak, so every district's first report is a backlog. Masking week zero also closed an unlooked-for leak, since week zero was the first support week for every district and those fabricated backlogs dominated the pooled scaler for the entire held-out disease. Cost: 61 cells.

nodes.label: Ebola cumulative-to-incidence conversion procedure
nodes.rationale: HDX sub-national values are cumulative situation-report counts; feeding them raw would train the model on a monotone step function. Resample to MMWR weeks taking the last cumulative value, difference the running maximum, mask weeks falling below it, mask the first observed week, mask forward-filled weeks.

nodes.label: few_shot_support_cutoff parameter (decision D22)
nodes.rationale: Window size is a parameter, so widening the cutoff is a rebuild rather than a code change; it must be decided together with the causality property, since a later cutoff pulls more of the epidemic into support.

nodes.label: COVID-19 US-states bundle EDA
nodes.rationale: 49 nodes x 164 weeks, fully observed, standard fixed_50_20_30 and per_node_train scaler; the shortest development panel. M is all-ones by construction because absence before a state's first case is a genuine zero, not a missing observation, so COVID contributes no zero-fill covariate shift and the LOCF input fill is a no-op.

nodes.label: Register of corrections to earlier releases of the audit note
nodes.norm_label: register of corrections to earlier releases of the audit note
nodes.rationale: Recorded so a figure quoted from an earlier draft can be identified as superseded: the clip justification, the 8,612/33,164 arithmetic, the 1,667 observed cells, the districts with no query week, the 30 zero-variance nodes, the single-phase invariant, the country-macro claim, the 'countries are not adjacent' premise, the new-cases sparsity claim, and the x220 case-definition multipliers.

nodes.label: Per-bundle dataset quality metrics table
nodes.rationale: Generated by data_quality.py from data/processed/*.npz: completeness, max gap, zero share, flat runs, zero-variance nodes, p99/median, isolated nodes, origin counts and channel counts for all six bundles.

nodes.label: Gap-lumping - disclosed, not corrected (decision A4)
nodes.rationale: Differencing recovers how many cases accrued between two reports but not when within the interval, so where a district falls silent and then files, the whole multi-week increment is stamped on the week the report arrived - 7 per cent of intervals exceed one week, the longest is 24, and Montserrado carries 1,428 cases on 2014-10-25. No cases are invented and the curve is correctly shaped, but weekly peaks are inflated and their neighbours flattened. Both remedies change the target - one invents an unobserved within-gap distribution, the other discards evaluation data - so the decision is to disclose and proceed, repeating the caveat wherever a weekly Ebola magnitude is quoted.

nodes.label: Ebola 'new cases' series adopted as a cross-check
nodes.norm_label: ebola 'new cases' series adopted as a cross-check
nodes.rationale: It had been declined as sparser and inconsistently capitalised; the capitalisation is handled by the same canonicalisation as every other field and the series carries 95 per cent of the cumulative series' coverage. It is a directly reported incidence series, so it needs no differencing and cannot be corrupted by the clip class of defect - had it been used as a cross-check the defect would have been caught immediately. Changing the target now would invalidate the build, so it is adopted as a cross-check instead, letting the target's credibility rest on two independently reported series.

nodes.label: Two alias maps per disease, separated in time
nodes.norm_label: two alias maps per disease, separated in time
nodes.rationale: The load-time map repairs the case data and must run before aggregation because it reunites units whose series the source split across two spellings; but a load-time alias necessarily rewrites the node identifier, so a shapefile misspelling folded into it propagates into the project's own identifiers. Inverting the entries does not achieve the same thing - it is the separation in time that is required, not a change of direction.

nodes.label: Name join verified against codes (decision D17, rationale corrected)
nodes.norm_label: name join verified against codes (decision d17, rationale corrected)
nodes.rationale: The original D17 reasoning (no code columns supplied) was wrong, but a code join is not the fix it appears to be: FAO_GAUL_code is not injective on our nodes (7,443 -> 7,027, Taiwan alone collapsing 287->2), RNE_iso maps to GADM ISO_1 at only ~74 per cent, and GADM carries no code for 1,476 Admin-2 nodes. Where a code does exist it is used as an oracle, not a key - Brazil's IBGE_code matches GADM CC_2 for all 5,517 nodes and the name join lands on the identical polygon for every one.

nodes.label: D8: The CSV Skip Trap
nodes.rationale: HeatGNN's trainer exits immediately when the results CSV holds a matching row, while the runner decides work from prediction npz files, so a row without an npz blocks that run forever.

nodes.norm_label: option 5: epidemic-specific gnns (reject trunk, borrow motifs)
nodes.rationale: EpiGNN is provably size-locked via a learnable NxN matrix; mechanistic-prior models bake in disease-specific compartmental parameters that violate disease-agnosticism. Cola-GNN's location-aware attention and EpiGNN's multi-scale temporal convolutions are transferable motifs.

nodes.rationale: Every locked-shortlist baseline on the common pipeline, all four datasets and horizons, each validated against its source paper's published numbers before it may enter the comparison table.

nodes.rationale: Seed standard deviation of exactly 0.00 at h5, h10 and h15 on dengue and on influenza-japan, flagged as worth a look and elsewhere recorded as a Section-A reproduction failure.

nodes.rationale: One row per decision that would be expensive to re-litigate, with client decisions marked and a reversed-or-superseded table at the end.

nodes.label: D11: Independent Audit of Steps 1 and 2, Both Green
nodes.norm_label: d11: independent audit of steps 1 and 2, both green
nodes.rationale: Audited against artifacts on disk rather than against claims: the run plan was re-derived without trusting remaining(), and all 16 RMSE cells were re-derived from raw JSON without importing analysis.py. Left open: results/lodo JSONs were produced by a version of train/lodo.py that was never committed, so the transfer table's evidentiary base has zero version provenance.

nodes.label: D15: Capacity Probe Runs with an In-Domain Control Arm
nodes.norm_label: d15: capacity probe runs with an in-domain control arm
nodes.rationale: Run alone the probe cannot separate a genuine transfer bottleneck from an adapter that was undersized all along and helps everywhere; the control costs no second trunk run and is what makes the result interpretable. The verdict is derived mechanically in code so the call is not a matter of taste.

nodes.label: D17: The Trunk Early Stop Was Real and Cost Nothing
nodes.norm_label: d17: the trunk early stop was real and cost nothing
nodes.rationale: All 15 LDO3 trunks burned exactly 12,000 steps after their best checkpoint, so the cosine schedule scaled to 91,000 steps was a no-op and no trunk could be called converged. A patience-999 rerun found the best value at step 7,000 and never improved, and the scored records are bit-identical, so the verdict does not move; the fix ships anyway because the mismatch will bite a longer-training configuration.

nodes.label: D18: The Single-Disease Ceiling Early-Stops Too, 25 of 25
nodes.norm_label: d18: the single-disease ceiling early-stops too, 25 of 25
nodes.rationale: Every transfer number is a ratio against the ceiling, so if only the transfer arm stopped early the deficit would be partly self-inflicted. The attack is removed, but the bias direction runs against transfer: if the ceiling sits below its own optimum the reported deficit understates the true gap. The arms stop on different clocks and the behaviour varies by dataset, so this is not an equal handicap.

nodes.label: D19: Adapter Capacity at Five Seeds
nodes.norm_label: d19: adapter capacity at five seeds
nodes.rationale: Seed-paired deltas against each seed's own affine control: 7 of 36 cross-disease cells clear zero, all at h15, and the in-domain control gains nothing in 12, so the effect is transfer-specific. The caveat that must travel with it is that h15 is exactly where the frozen Ebola primary arm has zero adaptation pairs, and changing the surface now would void the pre-registration.

nodes.label: D6: HeatGNN Epoch Budget Stays at the Paper's 1500
nodes.norm_label: d6: heatgnn epoch budget stays at the paper's 1500
nodes.rationale: An earlier 150-epoch run was the deviation, not the standard; cutting epochs would mean diverging from the paper while claiming a match, so speed must come from parallelism instead.

nodes.label: D7: HeatGNN NaN Fixed with Self-Loops on the Staged Graph Only
nodes.norm_label: d7: heatgnn nan fixed with self-loops on the staged graph only
nodes.rationale: getLaplaceMat never folds in the identity and the block that would is commented out, so an isolated node is scaled by ~1e12 rather than erroring; the forward survives and the backward overflows. Japan and us-states each carry two degree-0 nodes and us-regions carries none, which is why only us-regions trained.

nodes.label: D7a: EpiGNN Islands Documented, Not Rerun
nodes.norm_label: d7a: epignn islands documented, not rerun
nodes.rationale: EpiGNN's getLaplaceMat is byte-identical and equally lacks the identity but survives because it has no SIR loss to amplify it; dropping islands shifts node_mean in opposite directions on the two panels, so it is idiosyncrasy not bias. The evidence does not show what EpiGNN would score with self-loops.

nodes.label: D9: HeatGNN Runtime Model and Launch Config
nodes.norm_label: d9: heatgnn runtime model and launch config
nodes.rationale: Cost tracks training windows, not nodes: japan has 4.7x the nodes of us-regions and runs 2x faster. Not thread-bound, so parallelism is near-linear, and per-run cost must not be projected as s/epoch times 1500 because runs early-stop near 440 epochs.

nodes.label: Add ARIMA/SARIMA and a Gradient-Boosted Lag Model
nodes.norm_label: add arima/sarima and a gradient-boosted lag model
nodes.rationale: The GBM in particular is hard to beat and it is better to find that out internally than from a reviewer.

nodes.label: Reproduction Failure Log
nodes.rationale: Publishable on its own and far easier to keep as you go than to reconstruct at the end; combined with pre-registration it gives a credibility story most submissions in this space cannot tell.

nodes.label: export_baseline.py - export, do not port
nodes.rationale: EpiGNN/src, colagnn/src and HeatGNN-14DB/src each contain the same {data, layers, models, train, utils}.py structure - one code lineage consuming a [T,N] matrix plus an [N,N] adjacency, which is our bundles transposed. One ~40-line exporter covers three comparators; porting our loader into each repository would mean maintaining three forks of code we do not own. Two things must cross or the comparison is invalid: our split (the baselines' internal 50/20/30 coincides with ours on influenza but not on per-country dengue) and our mask (dengue is 21.75 per cent observed, and scoring baselines on 78 per cent fabricated zeros rigs the comparison in our favour, which is worse than losing).

nodes.label: COVID vs influenza on the identical 49 nodes
nodes.norm_label: covid vs influenza on the identical 49 nodes
nodes.rationale: This is the reason the bundle exists. The graph and covariates are bit-identical and the node ids are disjoint, while Spearman 0.695 on node totals means the two diseases rank the same states similarly but far from identically. A transfer result between these two bundles therefore isolates disease transfer from graph transfer, which no other cross-disease cell in the study can do.

nodes.label: US matrices identified as CDC ILINet at a known vintage
nodes.norm_label: us matrices identified as cdc ilinet at a known vintage
nodes.rationale: What began as calendar reconstruction ended as provenance identification: 759 of 785 regional rows are identical to ILINet across all ten regions simultaneously and the state matrix matches 97.5 per cent of cells, the residue being post-hoc backfill. Row 368 equals epiweek 200942 to the case, fixing the start at 2002-10-05 - a far stronger pin than the earlier post-hoc argument that chose the series maximum and then chose the event explaining it. Both US anchors were 39 weeks out under the obvious January reading, putting the seasonality channels ~180 degrees out of phase, and a row-count test could not catch it because the count matches under either anchor.

nodes.label: Influenza bundles - ColaGNN benchmark matrices used unchanged
nodes.norm_label: influenza bundles - colagnn benchmark matrices used unchanged
nodes.rationale: Purpose is exact comparability: results are meant to sit directly beside published baselines, which requires an identical graph, so Delphi's live API and the WHO global database were both rejected on the same ground. The three benchmarks have disjoint node sets and different calendars and are produced as three independent datasets rather than one stitched matrix - and independence is asserted at build time rather than merely intended, so the instruction not to concatenate is a checked property.

nodes.label: Influenza covariates validated against independently-known geography
nodes.norm_label: influenza covariates validated against independently-known geography
nodes.rationale: A mis-joined geometry fails silently - plausible numbers attached to the wrong nodes, with nothing downstream complaining. Each region's area equals the sum of its member states' areas although the two geometries are built by different routes, and the regional-minus-state total is exactly Florida plus DC, precisely the units the regional series includes and the 49-state series excludes. This is a third independent confirmation of the recovered node orderings.

nodes.label: Japan calendar pinned to the week against NIID season peaks
nodes.norm_label: japan calendar pinned to the week against niid season peaks
nodes.rationale: Formerly justified on seasonal phase alone (+/-4 weeks). The 2018/19 maximum lands on 2019-01-26 and the 2017/18 maximum on 2018-02-03, each the exact epidemiological week NIID records, and a one-week shift would move at least one maximum off its dated week. Re-asserted on every run by japan_calendar_pin.py.

nodes.label: Japanese prefecture ordering recovered from three independent lines of evidence
nodes.norm_label: japanese prefecture ordering recovered from three independent lines of evidence
nodes.rationale: The nodes are anonymous indices and a wrong ordering would silently corrupt any covariate join. Graph isomorphism pins 41 of 47 uniquely; population correlation (Spearman +0.949 with mean case counts) separates the automorphic orbits; and seasonal phase identifies Okinawa, which is five standard deviations below the national winter concentration. Kochi/Kagawa is the weakest identification and is recorded as moderate confidence - a transposition changes no model result because the nodes are automorphic, and would matter only for a covariate join.

nodes.label: Per-country chronological 50/20/30 split
nodes.rationale: A single global positional cut on the union calendar would starve Brazil, Japan, Ecuador, Panama and Argentina of training cells entirely - silently, since no schema check would fail. Every node of a country takes that country's boundary without exception, which keeps the block-diagonal graph temporally consistent: a GNN aggregates over neighbours, so a training cell beside a test cell in the same week would pull the test period into the training forward pass. The earlier per-node fallback that guaranteed each node a training cell is removed; the 475 affected nodes now take their country's pooled training statistics.

nodes.label: Phase-purity gate on split columns
nodes.rationale: No (country, week) column may hold cells from more than one split phase, so a training cell never sits beside a test cell in a neighbourhood a graph network aggregates over. The note previously asserted this invariant while the code violated it on 792 columns holding 31 per cent of observed cells.

nodes.label: Where each disease's scaler is fitted
nodes.norm_label: where each disease's scaler is fitted
nodes.rationale: Dengue per node on its own country's training cells, influenza per node on the training slice, Ebola pooled over support cells only. The Ebola case is the sharpest: two weeks per node is far too little to estimate a stable per-node scale, and fitting beyond support would leak the outbreak's magnitude into a result presented as few-shot.

nodes.label: G6 - Competitive performance vs SOTA re-run under identical conditions
nodes.norm_label: g6 - competitive performance vs sota re-run under identical conditions
nodes.rationale: Re-running baselines on identical data, splits, preprocessing, metrics and horizon is the only basis on which a SOTA claim survives review.

nodes.rationale: Ran at h=1 and its paper reports Japan RMSE in thousands, so the units must be watched when re-running at our horizons.

nodes.label: LTR degree encoding adopted from the EpiGNN lineage
nodes.norm_label: ltr degree encoding adopted from the epignn lineage
nodes.rationale: Encodes each node's self-loop-inclusive degree as a learned feature using the same D-tilde already computed for the normalisation step, at a cost of roughly 130 parameters, and the weights are shared and disease-agnostic. It is retained despite a caveat that must be stated: degree is a structural quantity correlating with which dataset is being processed, so LTR is the one shared component with a residual disease-identifiability surface - kept because the signal is epidemiologically motivated and the alternative is discarding local transmission structure entirely.

nodes.label: Baselines re-run under identical conditions
nodes.rationale: Prefer official code; where none exists, validate a from-scratch reimplementation against the paper's reported numbers before comparing.

nodes.label: Baseline block dominates the compute budget
nodes.norm_label: baseline block dominates the compute budget
nodes.rationale: 4-5 models x 4 datasets x 4 horizons x 5 seeds is 320-400 runs, because unlike our direct multi-horizon encoder the baselines train one model per horizon. It is compute-bound, not developer-bound, so it launches on Day 15 and grinds through Week 4 with a Day-20 checkpoint. If the schedule slips, cut baseline seeds before baseline models - a three-seed comparison across five comparators is more defensible than a five-seed comparison against two - and log whatever is cut, because a silently truncated comparison reads as a complete one.

nodes.label: Standardise horizons and metric definitions before any table is drawn
nodes.norm_label: standardise horizons and metric definitions before any table is drawn
nodes.rationale: The reproduction record shows why this is the top threat to a SOTA claim: one model ran at h=1 against a paper reporting {2,3,5,10,15}, another reports RMSE in thousands, a third logs MAPE as a fraction where its paper prints percentage points. Fix the grid at {3,5,10,15}, save every baseline's raw predictions, recompute every metric through our score.py, and never copy a number out of a baseline's own log.

nodes.label: The head-to-head must compare like with like, and Ebola has no fair comparator
nodes.norm_label: the head-to-head must compare like with like, and ebola has no fair comparator
nodes.rationale: Every baseline is single-disease by construction, so the G6 comparison is our encoder trained single-disease against baselines trained single-disease; the transfer-trained variant is a separate, additional row, because reporting it as the head-to-head would compare a model that saw four datasets against models that saw one. On Ebola no baseline can do few-shot adaptation at all, so a large margin over a comparator that cannot in principle do the task is evidence that the regime is hard, not that the model is good - the honest claim is that the framework produces usable forecasts where incumbents produce none.

nodes.norm_label: d14: no further trunk run without checkpointing and quantile archiving

nodes.rationale: Five seeds are already trained, so averaging their quantiles is free variance reduction and helps most on the noisy small datasets; Ebola-safe because the few-shot adapters can be ensembled too.

nodes.label: Amendment A7: Both Arms Archive Count-Space Quantiles
nodes.norm_label: amendment a7: both arms archive count-space quantiles
nodes.rationale: The zero-shot arm wrote no quantiles, exactly the omission that cost the development-fold zero-shot arm its whole UQ block; under score-once a quantile array not written now can never be written, so WIS, CRPS, coverage and PIT would be permanently unavailable.

nodes.rationale: G4 requires calibrated uncertainty but the variant is unsettled, so the mechanism is registered and the variant left open under four binding constraints: post hoc only, reported alongside never instead, never selected on Ebola, truth consumption declared.

nodes.norm_label: quantile archiving on every future run
nodes.rationale: Cheap on a new run and expensive to retrofit; it is the largest outstanding gap against the required metric set and blocks G4 entirely, so merging it into the meta-learning runs converts two jobs into one.

nodes.norm_label: reserve the conformal calibration split now
nodes.rationale: Vanilla split conformal assumes exchangeability and the setup breaks it on two axes at once, temporal dependence and shift onto an unseen disease; a shift and time aware variant must be picked before the Ebola work because retrofitting the split is painful.

nodes.label: Required Metric Set (WIS, CRPS, Coverage, PIT, Peak, Scale-Normalised)
nodes.norm_label: required metric set (wis, crps, coverage, pit, peak, scale-normalised)
nodes.rationale: RMSE, MAE and PCC will not satisfy epidemic-forecasting reviewers and the project claims calibrated uncertainty; scale-normalised error is needed because across 7,165 dengue regions raw RMSE is dominated by the biggest ones.

nodes.label: WIS and CRPS Are the Same Number on a Symmetric 5-Level Grid
nodes.norm_label: wis and crps are the same number on a symmetric 5-level grid
nodes.rationale: Algebraically identical on this grid, so both columns are printed only because the Review Doc names both metrics and they must not be cited as independent evidence; they would separate only on an asymmetric or denser grid.

nodes.label: Coverage Table: What Actually Exists on Disk
nodes.norm_label: coverage table: what actually exists on disk
nodes.rationale: Seed counts per regime and dataset are printed first because a 1-seed cell cannot carry a dispersion figure, so the client's standard is unmet there by data rather than by choice.

nodes.label: Like-for-Like Node-Population Check
nodes.rationale: score.py drops constant-truth nodes and a different prediction can change which nodes qualify, so equal node counts are checked per dataset, horizon and seed rather than assumed.

nodes.label: PCC Deltas Reported in Correlation Points
nodes.norm_label: pcc deltas reported in correlation points
nodes.rationale: A correlation is signed and can sit near zero, where a percent change explodes or flips sign on a model that genuinely improved.

nodes.label: score.py extended to the full metric protocol
nodes.norm_label: score.py extended to the full metric protocol
nodes.rationale: Extend the METRICS dict; do not rewrite the aggregation, which is the verified part. Adds sMAPE, peak intensity error and peak timing error, with CRPS/PICP/width following once intervals exist. Two existing rules the new metrics must not break: metrics are computed in count space against the bundle's raw, and genuinely constant nodes are excluded - peak timing on a constant node is undefined, so that exclusion is exactly right. The only data-layer exception to the Phase-3 code freeze, because it is a metrics module.

nodes.label: Country-macro headline metric (score.py)
nodes.rationale: Scored per node over observed test cells, averaged within each country, then across the twelve countries with equal weight, with the equal-node average alongside as the secondary figure. It neutralises Brazil's 77 per cent node share without discarding data, which is what makes keeping all nodes sound. Self-tested: a Bolivia-only error of 10 moves the equal-node mean 0.015 and the country-macro 0.833, about 10/12.

nodes.label: Four Guinean districts that record no incidence at all
nodes.norm_label: four guinean districts that record no incidence at all
nodes.rationale: They reported for six to forty-one weeks but never recorded a new case: their one to three cases predate their first report and therefore sit in the masked backlog. Correct, not a defect. Retained as real districts and valid neighbours, and unlike Japan's zero-variance dengue nodes their scaler cannot degenerate, because the Ebola scaler is pooled across the disease rather than fitted per node.

nodes.label: Zero-variance node guard and its mis-fire
nodes.norm_label: zero-variance node guard and its mis-fire
nodes.rationale: The guard fires on 400 of 7,165 nodes, not the 30 earlier reported - the earlier figure counted only nodes constant across their entire history, while the guard fires on any node with no variance inside its training window. 76 of the 400 had real held-out variance and the blanket sd=1 guard left them un-normalised on the raw log1p scale while every neighbour was standardised. The country-pooled fallback now applies, computed from training cells only so no leakage is introduced, and the blanket guard now fires on zero nodes.

nodes.label: Shuffled-adjacency negative control
nodes.rationale: Performance must degrade on dengue; if it does not, the spatial channel is decorative and that must be reported honestly.

nodes.label: G2 - Transferable representations across data-rich diseases
nodes.norm_label: g2 - transferable representations across data-rich diseases
nodes.rationale: Evidenced by leave-one-disease-out; a single development disease would make the general-framework claim non-credible.

nodes.label: Dengue is 98 per cent of the development corpus
nodes.norm_label: dengue is 98 per cent of the development corpus
nodes.rationale: A new finding for Phase 3 and distinct from the Brazilian dominance already settled - that one is within dengue, this one is across diseases: 98.5 per cent of nodes and 98.1 per cent of observed cells. Sample uniformly from the pooled corpus and the shared encoder sees influenza in roughly one update in fifty; it will not be a disease-agnostic encoder but a dengue encoder that has glanced at influenza, and the transfer claim is then unsupported by the training procedure that produced it.

nodes.label: Disease-balanced sampling [CONFIRM-P2]
nodes.rationale: Default: sample the dataset uniformly per batch, then origins within it, with square-root weighting recorded as a Week-6 ablation. The encoder must be equally at home on a 10-node US-regions graph and a 7,165-node dengue graph, because Ebola's 61 nodes resemble neither in scale - a dengue-dominated encoder has no reason to have learned anything that transfers to a small graph. Since an example is a whole-graph origin and the datasets differ in N and T, batches contain one dataset at a time; gradient accumulation over a round-robin is the simple correct implementation.

nodes.label: Leave-one-disease-out zero-shot transfer
nodes.rationale: Train the shared encoder on three development datasets and evaluate on the fourth with no adaptation - the first direct evidence for G2. Report against two references: the single-disease model on the held-out dataset (the ceiling) and the naive floors, since the interesting quantity is where zero-shot sits between them. Watch for the tell: if zero-shot dengue->influenza is surprisingly strong, check that no geographic or scale information is leaking, because northern/southern-hemisphere phase is legitimate shared signal but anything beyond it deserves a second look.

nodes.label: The naive sanity floors (persistence, seasonal naive, per-node train mean)
nodes.norm_label: the naive sanity floors (persistence, seasonal naive, per-node train mean)
nodes.rationale: If the encoder does not beat all three on every dataset and horizon, the problem is in the harness, not the architecture. Costs an hour and has caught this class of bug in every project that has bothered.

nodes.label: results/*.json - every table and figure generated, not typed
nodes.norm_label: results/*.json - every table and figure generated, not typed
nodes.rationale: One record per model x dataset x horizon x seed x metric. Every table and figure is generated from this file by a script and no number is ever typed into the manuscript by hand, which is what makes the final consistency check mechanical rather than an act of faith.

nodes.label: Significance battery (Diebold-Mariano, Friedman, Nemenyi)
nodes.rationale: DM per model pair per dataset per horizon with the Harvey-Leybourne-Newbold small-sample correction. DM operates on a series of loss differentials, so the node panel must be reduced to one value per time step before testing and that reduction stated. Then Friedman across (dataset x horizon) blocks with models as treatments, and Nemenyi post-hoc for the critical-difference diagram, on seed-averaged predictions.

nodes.label: Six-week milestone plan (30 working days)
nodes.rationale: Milestones run in dependency order; two activities span phases by design - baseline reproduction starts W1 and is re-run on harmonised data in W3, and manuscript drafting starts in parallel from W4 so W6 is assembly rather than writing from scratch.

nodes.label: manuscript_reconciliation.md - eight edits, item 1 first
nodes.rationale: Equation (4) still prints the retracted clip formula that fabricated 35.8 per cent of the Ebola target. It is a correctness defect sitting in a methods description, so it must not survive into a submitted draft - and no results table quotes it, which is the only reason it is still merely a defect and not a retraction. Apply it early so it cannot be quoted anywhere.

nodes.label: Brazilian dominance and the sampler decision
nodes.norm_label: brazilian dominance and the sampler decision
nodes.rationale: Brazil supplies 77.0 per cent of dengue nodes. Reporting is de-biased by the country-macro metric rather than by discarding nodes. Uniform node sampling stays primary - the encoder is data-proportional and therefore Brazil-weighted, which preserves the full training signal - and a country-balanced sampler is built as an ablation, decided empirically rather than by decree.

nodes.label: Constant nodes excluded from scoring, retained in the graph
nodes.norm_label: constant nodes excluded from scoring, retained in the graph
nodes.rationale: 29 of Japan's 47 prefectures report zero dengue in every observed week - true zeros, since dengue is not endemic there. A constant prediction is trivially exact on such a node and its correlation is undefined, so under a country-macro headline Japan's twelfth of the score would substantially measure the prediction of a constant. 559 nodes are constant over their test window and excluded; 6,161 are scored; Japan is also reported with them removed as a sensitivity. They stay in the graph as valid message-passing neighbours.

nodes.label: Ebola metric rules pre-registered before any Ebola number exists
nodes.norm_label: ebola metric rules pre-registered before any ebola number exists
nodes.rationale: A choice made in Week 5 with the data in hand cannot be shown to be independent of it, and a reviewer is entitled to assume the worst. MAE and RMSE are primary; PCC is reported only over districts with at least 5 observed non-zero cells with the qualifying count printed beside it; sMAPE inherits the 0/0-excluded rule and is dropped entirely if qualifying cells fall below 30 per cent of the query set; peak timing excludes districts with no peak and reports the count.

nodes.label: sMAPE definition pinned, 0/0 cells excluded
nodes.rationale: Two definitions are in circulation, so pin mean(2|y_hat - y| / (|y| + |y_hat|)) x 100, range 0-200. Cells where both are zero are undefined and must be excluded from the mean rather than counted as zero error: dengue is 78 per cent imputed and Ebola carries four districts that never record a case, so a '0/0 counts as perfect' convention would hand the model a large free credit on exactly the sparsest data.

nodes.label: Statistical reporting decided before results exist
nodes.norm_label: statistical reporting decided before results exist
nodes.rationale: Five seeds with no intervals will not survive review. All comparisons are paired on identical origin sets; report mean plus 95 per cent bootstrap CI over origins as the primary evidence and a paired Wilcoxon signed-rank across seed-matched runs as supporting evidence. With n=5 the test is underpowered, so lead with the interval and do not claim significance off five points.
